source: Local spike profiling and chapter preparation, chapters 1–5; generated profiles, not manually verified
title: Pride and Prejudice

speakers.name: Mr. Bennet
speakers.personality: Sarcastic, reserved, capricious, with a dry teasing wit; amused by vexing his wife and quietly fond of his daughter Lizzy.
speakers.speakingStyle: Dry, ironic, understated; answers indirectly and turns his wife's remarks into deadpan jokes.
speakers.voiceDescription: Measured, dry, unhurried male voice with a wry, teasing edge and frequent deadpan delivery.

speakers.name: Mrs. Bennet
speakers.personality: Nervous, excitable, of mean understanding and uncertain temper; obsessed with marrying off her daughters and fond of visiting and news.
speakers.speakingStyle: Anxious, exclamatory and repetitive; calls her husband 'my dear' and dwells on her poor nerves and her daughters' prospects.
speakers.voiceDescription: High, quick, fussy female voice, often flustered and exclamatory; prone to rising, indignant emphasis.

speakers.name: Elizabeth Bennet
speakers.personality: Quick-witted, lively and sensible, with a playful readiness to answer her father in kind.
speakers.speakingStyle: Bright, direct and good-humoured; practical and gently teasing.
speakers.voiceDescription: Clear, intelligent young female voice with a light, amused tone.

speakers.name: Kitty Bennet
speakers.personality: Fretful and easily scolded; defensive about her coughing.
speakers.speakingStyle: Petulant and mildly complaining; deflects by changing the subject.
speakers.voiceDescription: Light, slightly whiny young female voice with a fretful edge.

speakers.name: Lydia Bennet
speakers.personality: Bold, confident and forward; unafraid of social situations.
speakers.speakingStyle: Stout, self-assured and eager; speaks up readily.
speakers.voiceDescription: Bright, bold young female voice with confident, upbeat energy.

speakers.name: Mr. Bingley
speakers.personality: Lively, unreserved, amiable and good-natured; eager to dance and pleased with everyone.
speakers.speakingStyle: Warm, enthusiastic and exclamatory; presses his friend cheerfully and praises the company openly.
speakers.voiceDescription: Pleasant, energetic young male voice, friendly and warmly enthusiastic.

speakers.name: Mr. Darcy
speakers.personality: Proud, fastidious and reserved; above his company and above being pleased, cold in his judgments.
speakers.speakingStyle: Formal, clipped and disdainful; speaks in blunt, superior declarations.
speakers.voiceDescription: Deep, cool, refined male voice with a crisp, haughty edge.

speakers.name: Jane Bennet
speakers.personality: Sweet, candid and good-natured, honestly blind to the follies of others; speaks what she thinks and wishes not to censure anyone harshly.
speakers.speakingStyle: Gentle, earnest and warm; praises others generously and gently protests her sister's teasing.
speakers.voiceDescription: Soft, warm, sincere young female voice with a gentle, admiring tone.

speakers.name: Charlotte Lucas
speakers.personality: Sensible, intelligent and composed; practical about pride and social realities, and Elizabeth's intimate friend.
speakers.speakingStyle: Calm, reasonable and quietly wry; offers balanced observations and mild, good-humoured teasing.
speakers.voiceDescription: Steady, clear young female voice with a composed, thoughtful and faintly amused tone.

speakers.name: Mary Bennet
speakers.personality: Bookish and self-satisfied; piques herself on the solidity of her moral reflections.
speakers.speakingStyle: Formal, sententious and lecture-like; delivers aphorisms on human nature drawn from reading.
speakers.voiceDescription: Precise, slightly prim young female voice with a didactic, self-assured cadence.

speakers.name: Young Lucas
speakers.personality: Boisterous and teasing; imagines the freedoms of wealth with boyish bravado.
speakers.speakingStyle: Blunt, boastful and childish; protests loudly when contradicted.
speakers.voiceDescription: High, lively boy's voice with cheeky, boastful energy.
